required_stages.description: Allocate C (M, N) of A's dtype inside run().
Per logical output tile: loop over K, accumulate products in fp32 (TF32 operands permitted for fp32, native fp16/fp8 otherwise, no scaling), cast once to C.dtype, store.

forbidden_substitutions.message: infix @ matrix multiply on the data path
transposed copy of B: permitted only per call inside run(), never cached across calls
host-side down-cast of an operand below its delivered precision
fp8 scale factors are not part of this operator

outputs.aliasing: none: fresh (M, N) tensor of A's dtype allocated inside run()

timing_boundary.notes: The GPU time of all device work launched by run() is counted; the output allocation call and descriptor/metadata construction are host-side work and not GPU time. A and B are consumed as delivered; any repack of B must be per call inside run() (its device time counted) and never cached; no prepacked inputs.
